messages:
Marta Alvarez: Small but important doc mismatch: POST /v1/classify OpenAPI schema marks 'labels' as required, but examples and SDK snippets omit it. This caused an SRE support ticket. I opened a PR to align YAML + examples: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4892
Jun Park: Thanks — will we make labels optional or update snippets to include it?
Marta Alvarez: We should keep it required server-side. Update examples (curl/py/js) and add a short migration note: many client helpers previously sent empty arrays implicitly. Recommend explicit labels: ["intent", "sentiment"].
Olivia Chen: Suggested snippets to paste into PR:

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/classify" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"text":"I love this product","labels":["sentiment","topic"]}'

# python
resp = client.post('/v1/classify', json={"text":"I love this product", "labels":["sentiment","topic"]})
print(resp.json())

// JS
const res = await client.post('/v1/classify', { text: 'I love this product', labels: ['sentiment','topic'] })
console.log(await res.json())

Marta Alvarez: Also update the OpenAPI requestBody to include examples and add a callout: "labels is required. Use an empty array only if you want default label set (not recommended)."
docs-bot: PR 4892 created and passed lint checks: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4892 :white_check_mark:
Jun Park: I'll push the YAML + HTML example updates now and tag Olivia for review.
